payload.symptoms: structural brain diseases (MUE, hydrocephalus, brain tumors) vs IE
payload.supporting_quote: Serum NfL concentration in dogs with each structural disease was significantly higher than in healthy dogs and dogs with IE (P = .01).

payload.comparison_population: patients with epilepsy (drug-resistant epilepsy) and healthy controls
payload.supporting_quote: Serum NfL levels were higher in patients with SE (median = 26.15 pg/ml) compared to both epilepsy patients (median = 7.35 pg/ml) and healthy controls (median = 6.81 pg/ml; p < .001).
There was no difference in serum NfL levels between the epilepsy and control groups (epilepsy [mean ± SD]: 17.3 ± 13.9 pg/mL; control: 17.7 ± 11.5 pg/mL; p = .92)
CSF and serum NfL levels were increased in patients with LD (mean sNfL 13.95, 95% CI 11.20-16.69; mean cNfL 576.9, 95% CI 465.3-688.5).
